basic_details.job_title: NIT Durgapur Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Technical Assistant, Research Associate Posts
basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Technology Durgapur (NIT Durgapur) has announced 2 temporary vacancies for Technical Assistant and Research Associate I posts. Qualifications vary by post, requiring specific degrees or diplomas as detailed in the official notification. Selected candidates will receive a monthly pay of Rs. 20,000 for Technical Assistant and Rs. 58,000 for Research Associate I, on a purely temporary engagement for a period of two years or until the end of the project under advertisement number NITD/SRCC/BKM/CHE/MP/01. Eligible applicants must apply by email within 14 days of the advertisem

important_dates.interview_date: To be notified via email to shortlisted candidates

how_to_apply: Prepare an updated CV containing a photograph, corresponding address, date of birth, phone number, email address, self-attested educational qualifications, self-attested experience certificates, and a list of publications (if applicable).
Send the updated CV via email to [email protected].
Ensure the email subject line reads “Application for TA in DBT Project 2026” for the Technical Assistant post or “Application for RA-1 in DBT Project 2026” for the Research Associate I post.
Submit the application within 14 days of the advertisement date (by 27 October 2026).
important_instructions: The prescribed educational qualifications are bare minimum requirements, and mere possession does not entitle candidates to be called for an interview. Canvassing in any form will be treated as a disqualification. Selected candidates must join duty immediately upon receipt of the offer letter. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Desirable Qualifications and Experience for Research Associate I: Preference will be given to candidates with research exposure to Gas Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry and Spectrophotometer handling, and basic modelling with at least one research paper in SCI journal. rows.essential_qualification: BTech/BE degrees in Chemical Engineering/ Mechanical Engineering or MSc in Biotechnology, Botany or Chemistry or 03 years Diploma in Engineering & Technology (with 02 years of experience) or equivalent from recognized Institute / Universities with minimum 6.0 CGPA or 55% marks. Candidates with higher qualifications may also apply.

PhD degree or equivalent in Biotechnology /Biological Sciences from reputed Institutes/Universities. Candidates should have expertise in cell culture, image analysis and advanced molecular cell biology, and biochemical techniques.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The positions are purely temporary for a period of two years or until the end of the project, whichever is earlier. Continuation is subject to candidate performance, which will be evaluated every six months. Selected candidates will receive consolidated fellowship amounts along with accommodation or House Rent Allowance (HRA) as per Institute norms.

content_sections.heading: NIT Durgapur Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The duties and responsibilities assigned to the posts include: Technical Assistant: Assist in routine laboratory work, sample, media and reagent preparation, sensor maintenance, pilot plant handling and operations, and record maintenance. Research Associate I: Conduct research activities involving cell culture, image analysis, advanced molecular cell biology, biochemical techniques, Gas Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry, spectrophotometer handling, and basic modelling.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Incomplete or incorrect applications will not be considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview and notified via email in due time. Shortlisted candidates must appear in person (offline) for the interview on the scheduled date, carrying an updated CV along with original and self-attested photocopies of mark sheets and certificates in support of academic qualifications. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Selected candidates must join duty immediately upon receipt of the offer.

faq.question: Q1. What is NIT Durgapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: NIT Durgapur Recruitment 2026 is a hiring notification issued by the Department of Chemical Engineering at NIT Durgapur for 1 Technical Assistant and 1 Research Associate I position under a DBT-funded project.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies: 1 post for Technical Assistant and 1 post for Research Associate I.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NIT Durgapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to send applications by email is 27 October 2026, which is within 14 days of the advertisement date of 13 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Technical Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold BTech/BE degrees in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or MSc in Biotechnology, Botany, or Chemistry, or a 03-year Diploma in Engineering & Technology with 2 years of experience (or equivalent) with a minimum of 6.0 CGPA or 55% marks.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Research Associate I?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years, with a 5-year age relaxation applicable for SC/ST/OBC/PWD and women candidates as of the last date of application.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for NIT Durgapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the NIT Durgapur project posts?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates must send an updated CV along with self-attested educational and experience certificates and publication lists to [email protected] with the specified subject line.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is based on shortlisting of applications followed by an offline personal interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Is the position permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The position is purely temporary for a period of two years or until the end of the project, whichever is earlier, subject to performance evaluation every six months.

faq.question: Q10. What allowances are provided in addition to the fellowship?
faq.answer: Selected candidates receive accommodation or House Rent Allowance (HRA) as per Institute norms in addition to the monthly fellowship amount.
